content_type.description: The mime type of the file.
content_type.title: Content Type

file_name.description: The name of the file. It will be auto-generated if not provided.
file_name.title: File Name

file_size.description: The size of the file in bytes.
file_size.title: File Size

url.description: The URL where the file can be downloaded from.
url.title: Url

WorkflowUtilitiesScaleVideoInput.description: Input model for scaling/resizing a video to specific dimensions

codec.description: Video codec to use for encoding. libx264 (H.264) is widely compatible, libx265 (H.265/HEVC) offers better compression.
codec.title: Codec

crf.description: Constant Rate Factor for quality (0-51). Lower values mean better quality and larger files. 18 is visually lossless for most content.
crf.title: Crf

height.description: Target height in pixels. If only height is provided, width is auto-calculated to preserve aspect ratio. At least one of width or height must be provided.
height.title: Height

mode.description: Scaling mode. 'stretch' scales the video to the exact target dimensions (may distort aspect ratio). 'pad' scales to fit within the target dimensions while preserving aspect ratio, then pads with the chosen color to fill the remaining space (letterbox/pillarbox). 'crop' scales to cover the target dimensions while preserving aspect ratio, then center-crops to the exact target size.
mode.title: Mode

pad_color.description: Padding color when mode is 'pad'. Ignored for other modes.
pad_color.title: Pad Color

preset.description: Encoding speed preset. Slower presets give better compression but take longer.
preset.title: Preset

video_url.description: URL of the video file to scale/resize. Height and Width of the video must be even numbers for compatibility with video codecs.
video_url.title: Video Url

width.description: Target width in pixels. If only width is provided, height is auto-calculated to preserve aspect ratio. At least one of width or height must be provided.
width.title: Width

WorkflowUtilitiesScaleVideoInput.title: ScaleVideoInput

original_height.description: Height of the original video in pixels
original_height.title: Original Height

original_width.description: Width of the original video in pixels
original_width.title: Original Width

scaled_height.description: Height of the output video in pixels
scaled_height.title: Scaled Height

scaled_width.description: Width of the output video in pixels
scaled_width.title: Scaled Width
